name: Connectivity and finite-size referee
task: Audit components/winding/susceptibility and evidence for boundaries across sizes.

name: Clustering intervention referee
task: Audit invariants, achieved contrast, proposal/mixing limitations and bending confounding.

name: Hub-bias and spatial graph referee
task: Audit degree bias, fragmentation, co-changing clustering, fixed-node interpretation.

name: Linear mechanics and null-control referee
task: Audit energy/force linearization, CG equilibrium, normalization and selective versus homogeneous relaxation.

name: Replication and uncertainty referee
task: Audit matched-pair eligibility, seed reuse, complete-case selection, four-replica bootstrap and multiple comparisons.

name: Convergence and simulation-priority referee
task: Audit benchmark, central-force and dt refinement scope, numerical versus physical conclusions; prioritize next simulation.
